notes: With-skill achieves 100% pass rate across all 3 evals vs 73% baseline average
Baseline consistently fails on 'multi-source diagnosis' and 'confidence level' assertions - these are the key differentiators of the skill

Eval 2 (Build #3913) shows 100% pass for both configurations - the single-error, well-documented C1083 case is too easy for discrimination
The biggest quality gap is in root cause depth: baseline stops at surface-level analysis while skill reaches true root causes (e.g., IWYU violation vs 'missing implementation')
Knowledge base hits significantly boost skill performance - builds #3939 and #3913 both had exact KB matches
All with-skill runs correctly identified that fixes were already applied in subsequent builds - baseline did not check this
